It is located in {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156|lt=Mino Province}}.

It is one of the {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|ja|論社|qid=Q135022904}} for Arakata Shrine (Arakata Myōjin), a shikinaisha in {{ill|Anpachi District, Gifu|ceb|Ampachi-gun|es|Distrito de Anpachi (Gifu)|fa|شهرستان آنپاچی، گیفو|fr|District d'Anpachi|id|Distrik Anpachi, Gifu|it|Distretto di Anpachi|ja|安八郡|ko|안파치군|pl|Powiat Anpachi|pt|Distrito de Anpachi|uk|Повіт Ампаті|vi|Anpachi (huyện)|zh|安八郡|qid=Q1204320}}, {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}}. The other candidate shrine is {{ill|Sunomata Hachiman Shrine|ja|八幡神社 (大垣市墨俣町)|qid=Q11391073|lt=Hachiman Shrine}}.

Its original location is said to have been on the riverbed of the current {{ill|Sai River (Gifu)|fa|رود سای (گیفو)|fr|Sai-gawa (Gifu)|ja|犀川 (岐阜県)|qid=Q7399814|lt=Sai River}}, on the boundary between {{ill|Motosu District, Gifu|ceb|Motosu-gun|es|Distrito de Motosu (Gifu)|fr|District de Motosu|id|Distrik Motosu, Gifu|it|Distretto di Motosu|ja|本巣郡|ko|모토스군|pl|Powiat Motosu|pt|Distrito de Motosu|uk|Повіт Мотосу|vi|Motosu (quận)|zh|本巢郡|qid=Q1204331}} and Anpachi District.

== Overview ==
*It is located north of {{ill|Sunomata Castle|es|Castillo Sunomata|eu|Sunomata gaztelua|fa|قلعه سونوماتا|fr|Château de Sunomata|ja|墨俣城|ko|스노마타성|vi|Thành Sunomata|zh|墨俣城|qid=Q1036473}}, and the precinct is part of Ichiyajō-ato Park.
*There is Toyokuni Shrine as a precinct shrine. It was divided from {{ill|Hōkoku Shrine (Osaka)|abstract|Q704855|arz|ضريح هوكوكو|fa|معبد هوکوکو (اوساکا)|fr|Hōkoku-jinja|ja|豊國神社 (大阪市)|zh|豐國神社 (大阪市)|qid=Q704855|lt=Toyokuni Shrine}} in {{ill|Osaka Castle Park|fr|Parc du château d'Osaka|hu|Oszakai kastélypark|id|Taman Istana Osaka|ja|大阪城公園|jv|Taman Kadhaton Osaka|ko|오사카성 공원|my|အိုဆာကာရဲတိုက်ပန်းခြံ|vi|Công viên thành Osaka|wuu|大阪城公园|zh|大阪城公園|zh_yue|大阪城公園|qid=Q150118}} when the imitation {{ill|Tenshu|de|Tenshu|es|Tenshu|fr|Tenshu|ja|天守|ko|덴슈|ms|Tenshu|pt|Tenshu|ru|Тэнсю|sl|Tenšu|uk|Тенсю|zh|天守|qid=Q49144|lt=castle tower}} ({{ill|Sunomata Local History Museum|ja|大垣市墨俣歴史資料館|qid=Q115112030}}) of Sunomata Castle was built. == Transportation ==
*15 minutes on foot from “Sunomata” bus stop on the Gikaki Line of {{ill|Meihan Kintetsu Bus|ja|名阪近鉄バス|qid=Q11415818}}
**From stop 2 at {{ill|Ōgaki Station Bus Terminal|ja|大垣駅前バスのりば|qid=Q11433817}} (south of {{ill|Ōgaki Station|de|Bahnhof Ōgaki|eo|Stacio Ōgaki|fr|Gare d'Ōgaki|id|Stasiun Ōgaki|it|Stazione di Ōgaki|ja|大垣駅|jv|Setatsiyun Ōgaki|ko|오가키역|zh|大垣車站|qid=Q871579}}), bound for {{ill|Gifu Shotoku Gakuen University|ja|岐阜聖徳学園大学|qid=Q5560125}} or Gifu Ryūtsū Center South Gate
*15 minutes on foot from “Sunomata” bus stop on the Obusa-Sunomata line of {{ill|Gifu Bus|ja|岐阜乗合自動車|qid=Q5560101|lt=Gifu Noriai Jidōsha}}
**From stop 6 at {{ill|JR Gifu Station Bus Terminal|ja|JR岐阜駅バスターミナル|qid=Q11226229}} (north of {{ill|Gifu Station|arz|محطة جيفو|de|Bahnhof Gifu|eo|Stacio Gifu|fr|Gare de Gifu|id|Stasiun Gifu|it|Stazione di Gifu|ja|岐阜駅|jv|Setatsiyun Gifu|ko|기후역|my|ဂိဖုဘူတာ|su|Stasion Gifu|ur|گیفو اسٹیشن|zh|岐阜站|qid=Q1144885}}), bound for W65 Sunomata
**From stop 1 at {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu Boarding Area|ja|名鉄岐阜のりば|qid=Q11415771}} (west of {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu Station|de|Bahnhof Meitetsu Gifu|eo|Stacio Meitetsu-Gifu|fr|Gare de Meitetsu Gifu|id|Stasiun Meitetsu Gifu|ja|名鉄岐阜駅|jv|Setatsiyun Meitetsu Gifu|ko|메이테쓰기후역|su|Stasion Meitetsu Gifu|ur|میٹیٹسو گفو اسٹیشن|zh|名鐵岐阜站|qid=Q1109902}}), bound for W65 Sunomata
